defensiveAbilities.name: Swarm Mind
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster doesn't have a single mind (typically because it's a swarm of smaller creatures), and is immune to mental effects that target only a specific number of creatures. It is still subject to mental effects that affect all creatures in an area.

offensiveAbilities.name: Venom Spritz
offensiveAbilities.description: The vipers spray venom from their fangs in a defensive display. Each creature in a 10ft Type:cone is exposed to viper swarm venom but gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its initial saving throw against the poison.

offensiveAbilities.name: Venomous Fangs
offensiveAbilities.description: Each enemy in the swarm's space takes 2d8 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 21 Reflex Saving Throw save). A creature that fails their save is also exposed to viper swarm venom.

offensiveAbilities.name: Viper Swarm Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 21 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d4 Poison Damage damage (1 round)

Stage 2 1d6 Poison Damage damage and Clumsy 1 (1 round)

Stage 3 2d4 Poison Damage damage, Clumsy 2, and Enfeebled 1 (1 round)
